reviews.t: Disappointed The clippers don't work well
reviews.x: Disappointed The clippers don't work well. I will replace the instruments and keep the case and the bag. Should have taken the rating comments.

reviews.t: Clippers had probelmes that I had to spend a hour to correct.
reviews.x: This nail kit is OK, but had a few manufacturing problems. It appears that the bend that was placed on the metal was done in a way that caused the cutting edges to not line up correctly, causing them to overlap each other and not cut the nail correctly. It took me an hour to re-grind the clippers by hand to remove this imperfection. This issue occurred on both clippers in the same way. These clippers have a very strong spring to them. It makes the clippers difficult to use, especially difficult

reviews.t: I really get sick of companies producing junk with some nice material. Everything else is made nice
reviews.x: The large nail clippers came broken as well as the nail file.  Of course everything I bought with my order on Amazon this last time had some kind of defect. I really get sick of companies producing junk with some nice material. Everything else is made nice. The case is nice, overall the tools are nice. I think I will just super glue the file back in place rather then return. Somewhat disappointed.

A great set! Has all tools necessary for a perfect manicure including nail file, cuticle maintenance tools, & every other tool you would need. Case is small enough that you can easily bring with you while traveling. Highly recommend! A+

Worst clippers ever. I love the little tools, but the actual clippers are terrible. Instead of a usual pinch-and-squeeze method I had to use a gorilla grip to generate enough pressure to get the tool to actually cut through my nails. It seems like the metal that was used is too soft. I'll keep everything else in the kit but the clippers are getting tossed.

Very nice product and package. It addresses every possible need and some I may never need. Good value and good quality. I had a minor problem initially but the company addressed it immediately. I recommend this product for personal use or as a nice gift!
Excellent ladies style. Quality!!  At looking close One clipper does not works return Has nice case

Looks nice, isn't very practical. The Toe nail clipper came detached, and I've reassembled it many times. If you like/need really short nails this is not for you. The finger nail clipper is actually painful to use by the time you're done (for the hand holding it, not being cut). Very little control. I'll be replacing soon.

reviews.t: Nice package but the actual size of the set is ...
reviews.x: Nice package but the actual size of the set is still on the small size.  Most nail techs in the U.S. even though they are Asian prefer bigger sizes so they are hesitate to use the set.  The purpose for buying this type set is to have your own and not rely on your nail tech to reuse their set from customer to customer.

reviews.t: The product comes in a nice leather-like wrap and looks real nice
reviews.x: The product comes in a nice leather-like wrap and looks real nice...until I tried to use them. The smaller fingernail clipper was hard to use and didn't seem very sharp by the way it trimmed nails. The larger toenail clipper broke the first time I tried to use it. I am not impressed. Will try to return it.

reviews.t: High grade steel with very sharp cutting edges and alignment.
reviews.x: Very high quality steel in all tools in the set.  Cutting tools all have sharp edges and are in perfect alignment.  Case is high grade and makes a great gift.
Disappointed. The clippers don't clip in the way of others. They most just smash the nail and it cleaves off.  Most likely not sharp enough.

reviews.t: This is a great clipper set
reviews.x: This is a great clipper set! The case is so lovely! The pieces are a bit bulky, but very nice for the price.
One of the nail clippers broke immediately the first time I tried to close it.
The product arrived with broken clippers

I bought this as a gift for my husband because he works for a gardening company and constantly has dirt stuck in his nails. I wanted him to have a safer alternative for trimming and getting the dirt out than his pocketknife. He really likes the kit. He likes the leather case and that it keeps all the pieces neatly stored in one place. When it arrived, the lever on one of the clippers had come off during shipping, but it was easy for me to snap it back on before wrapping it. It came in a grey vel

Overall I’m happy to have a nice organized kit. The long pedicure tools (for lack of better words) are nice although not sure if it is surgical steel which I would prefer. Only down side I can see from first impression is that the clippers and tweezers seem generic and personally I could do without the buckle on front of case. All in all keeps tools organized and will get the job done

reviews.t: Amazing. Definitely a great looking kit to have around.
reviews.x: This was a great find. Purchased just to have a decent manicure kit to keep around, and it turned out to be incredibly well made, durable, and just -looks luxurious-  the leather is very smooth and the case itself fits just about anywhere. Awesome surprise that it turned out even better than we imagined.

I live on the road, so it's nice to have a professional grooming kit like this on the go. It's so nicely laid out. All the tools are easy to get. The entire case is made from leather, so you don't have to worry about thoes little straps like in other kites stretching out and breaking.

reviews.t: Made solid but there are smily face cutouts in metal tools.
reviews.x: Nice kit, looks to be made well. However, I bought for husband and there are smily face cutouts on all the tools lol...he kept it anyways  because we know that is part of Japanese culture and it brought back happy memories about Japan. I honestly thought he would send it back.
Nicest manicure set I've ever seen. The leather case is what really sets It off.  Our three boys who are grown adults now simply loved that item in their stocking during their visit on Christmas.
Haven't used this yet, but it looks great - exactly as pictured. Nice and neat and everything you need for a good manicure/pedicure. I will take this to the salon with me when I get my mani/pedi.
The  Keiby set has really good quality and I can honestly say that all the pieces feel to be of good quality.  So If you are interested, in  pedicure set this is the one you need.
I really like this set. The clipper set is a good quality and the case is very handsome and well made. My son and grandson are going to like this gift. Well worth the price.
A very nice set with high quality, heavy tools. The only downside is that, when closed, the case looks just like a woman's wallet.

claims.text: Many reviewers report the nail clippers are defective, broken, or fail to cut properly, including clippers arriving broken or breaking on first use.
Reviewers frequently praise the case and packaging as nice-looking and good for gifting or travel.
Several reviewers find the set offers good value and includes all the tools needed.
Some reviewers note the tools are bulky or small in size.
A few reviewers mention the company addressed problems promptly or that the steel quality is high.
